scripts.setup: npm install && (cd frontend && npm install) && (cd backend && npm install)
scripts.test: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend sh -c 'npm install && npm run test'
scripts.fix: docker compose run --rm --no-deps frontend sh -c 'npm install && npm run fix' && docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend sh -c 'npm install && npm run fix'
scripts.check: docker compose run --rm --no-deps frontend sh -c 'npm install && npm run check' && docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend sh -c 'npm install && npm run check && npm run test'
scripts.reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up --build
